issues.description: The problem statement's UML and method descriptions specify SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal) as returning void, but the solution implementation declares orderMeal as returning boolean. This discrepancy can confuse students about the expected signature and return behavior and may cause mismatches with any tests or the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across artifacts. Either change the solution (and template stub if added) so orderMeal has signature public void orderMeal(Meal meal) and return no value, or update the problem statement/UML to specify a boolean return type and explain the meaning of the return value. Ensure tests and any provided templates match the chosen signature.
